verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's first-party docs show natural-language operation through its remote MCP server, which lets users "analyze your data using natural language... without writing SQL". With query_rw, agents can also write and modify schemas. Dives build dashboards from prompts and refine them conversationally ("add a filter for US region", "switch to a bar chart"). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL experience, evidence of a built-in NL interface that doesn't depend on an external AI assistant connected over MCP, and NL coverage of admin tasks such as sharing, billing, or instance management.
